subject: [AMBER] Is error bar necessary for umbrella sampling?

messages.author: Qing Lv
messages.body:
Dear All,
I wonder if the error bars are necessary for umbrella sampling in PMF calculation? If yes, how should the error bars be calculated? Need I do 2~3 repeats (with different random initial velocities assigned)?
Thanks,
Qing

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
Error bars are not necessary unless you want to know how precise your
results might be. Otherwise you could have large uncertainties that you
cannot estimate. I expect that most journal reviewers would want them
included. Independent runs from different seeds are good, and in my opinion
runs from different initial structures can be better. Keep in mind that the
errors bars are a lower bound on the true uncertainty.

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
We just do the calculation twice (an independent data set) , so tools
aren't needed. If you mean making the graph with error bass from the 2 data
sets, amber doesn't really have graphing tools. Most programs (like
xmgrace) allow using 2 data sets to make error bars.
